genesis_realization.route_kind: direct PC090OJ selection of the already-resident shared Layer-A master line
genesis_realization.dynamic_behavior: stable for gameplay scene 1; the route selects line 3 and does not write CRAM
genesis_realization.shared_line_ownership: Line 3 remains owned by Layer A. Cave-block cells are offline-reindexed to the established muddy-ground entries 1..5; no duplicate palette and no palette-line steal.

decisions.decision_basis: The frozen Palette Composer context maps the Stage-1 muddy Layer-A ground source indices 9..13 to resident Line-3 entries 1..5. Raw cave-block indices are incompatible with those meanings, so only cells 0x0179..0x017C are reindexed. The authored map uses Palette Composer CIEDE2000 matching constrained to those five established ground entries; seven source indices necessarily collapse into the five shared ground colors. Visual acceptance remains with Tighe in BlastEm.
known_defects: Genesis color WRONG (deferred to Andy per Cody build0366): the genesis_realization Line-3 muddy-ground offline reindex (1->5,7->2,8->1,9->3,12->3,13->3,14->1) is a Genesis compatibility fit, NOT the arcade appearance, and was not visually accepted. H17 proves the arcade cave block is gray stone + brown (pool 35 / 0x50162), which the Genesis realization must reproduce rather than collapse into the muddy ground line.
